images.scope_evidence: Título del modelo: 'Axopar 29 CCX Fishing edition_DD8A9442'.

source_context.item_title: A more athletic appearance, with raised bulwarks, enhances offshore capability and safety while moving around the deck, even during intense fishing sessions. The integrated handrails help prevent fishing lines from snagging, and the optional coaming pads offer increased comfort.

images.title: Axopar 29 CCX Fishing edition_DD8A9087
images.scope_evidence: Título del modelo: 'Axopar 29 CCX Fishing edition_DD8A9087'.

source_context.item_title: The console features a forward-tilting, fully enclosed, toughened glass windshield and side windows, offering excellent protection from wind chill, spray, and rain, reducing glare and displacing rain and spray very effectively, so wipers are rarely needed.

images.title: Axopar_29CCX-6030
images.scope_evidence: Tag DAM del modelo (ax29, ax29ccx, ax29ccxlaunch, axopar, cannes, france).

source_context.item_title: The forward-extending hardtop contributes to the boat’s modern look, offering better sun protection and when needed, airflow for the driver through its integrated skylight located in front of the helm.

images.title: Axopar_29CCX-6731
images.scope_evidence: Tag DAM del modelo (ax29, ax29ccx, ax29ccxlaunch, axopar, cannes, france).

source_context.item_title: The familiar foredeck from the 29-range is carried over, seating up to eight people around an optional U-sofa extension and hi-lo table, which can be converted into a sunbed. Additionally, a fish box option is available on the CCX fore deck.

images.title: Axopar 29 CCX_099A2384
images.scope_evidence: Tag DAM del modelo (ax29, ax29ccx, axopar, brabusline, finland, finnboat25).

source_context.item_title: Together with a large, foldable table, the U-sofa option creates an immersive, sociable, multi seating arrangement around the cockpit.
